root_cause.hypothesis: The database connection pool reached its maximum limit (20 connections) and became exhausted, triggering the cascade of failures.
alternative_hypotheses: A sudden traffic spike caused an unexpected surge in concurrent DB connections, overwhelming the pool.
A connection leak in the payment-service prevented connections from being returned to the pool, leading to exhaustion.

recommendations.action: Increase the maximum size of the database connection pool to accommodate peak load and configure a reasonable overflow limit.
recommendations.rationale: A larger pool prevents exhaustion during traffic spikes, eliminating the root cause of connection shortages.

recommendations.action: Enable connection leak detection in the pool and automatically close connections that exceed a defined usage threshold.
recommendations.rationale: Detecting and reclaiming leaked connections stops gradual pool depletion that leads to exhaustion.

recommendations.action: Implement real‑time monitoring and alerting for pool metrics (active, idle, waiting connections) with thresholds set at 80% utilization.
recommendations.rationale: Early alerts allow operators to intervene before the pool reaches its limit.

recommendations.action: Review and optimize long‑running queries and transaction scopes to reduce the time each connection is held.
recommendations.rationale: Shorter connection lifetimes increase turnover, decreasing the chance of hitting the pool maximum.
